description: This file contains the implementation of the MembershipAgent class in the Orleans Runtime Membership Service. The class manages membership status updates, health checks, cluster connectivity validation, and lifecycle participation for a silo node, including updating 'I Am Alive' timestamps, handling state transitions, and observing the lifecycle events.

classes.name: MembershipAgent
classes.description: Handles membership updates and health checks for a silo in the Orleans cluster, including lifecycle management and connectivity validation.

classes.name: MembershipAgent.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Interface for test hooks within MembershipAgent to facilitate testing of internal behaviors.

classes.name: EnumerableToStringLogValue<T>
classes.description: Utility struct for logging collections of SiloAddress entities in a human-readable format.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Periodically updates the 'I Am Alive' timestamp in the membership table, with retry logic and exponential backoff.

methods.name: BecomeActive
methods.description: Transitions the silo to active state after initial connectivity validation.

methods.name: ValidateInitialConnectivity
methods.description: Checks that the silo can successfully communicate with other active silos before fully joining the cluster.

methods.name: BecomeJoining
methods.description: Sets the silo status to Joining during startup.

methods.name: BecomeShuttingDown
methods.description: Marks the silo as ShuttingDown during shutdown procedure.

methods.name: BecomeStopping
methods.description: Marks the silo as Stopping during shutdown.

methods.name: BecomeDead
methods.description: Marks the silo as Dead, typically upon failure or shutdown.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the current silo status in the membership table.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the MembershipAgent, including timers.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check based on 'I Am Alive' status.
